## Description

Fix the missing test that the phase reviewer found on move-store-client.

## Approach

Work on branch phase/standalone-aff in ~/orchestra. Do not edit the affidavit worktree.

Add a pytest in tests/test_affidavit_check.py that runs bin/orchestra check --help and bin/orchestra close-batch --help and asserts each exits 0. Do not change the CLI.

payload.title: Test orchestra check and close-batch help
